## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run validate` passes with no errors
- [ ] All IDs follow the [naming convention](../CONTRIBUTING.md#id-naming-conventions)
- [ ] Question title is concise (≤40 characters, no "What is..." prefix)
- [ ] Question body includes "Why This Is Asked" and "Key Concepts" sections
- [ ] Each new question has at least one variant
- [ ] Each variant includes: Expected Answer, Common Mistakes (≥2), Follow-up Questions (≥2)
- [ ] Code examples are real and runnable (no pseudocode)
- [ ] Difficulty level is [calibrated correctly](../docs/QUALITY_STANDARDS.md#difficulty-calibration)
- [ ] No duplicate content — checked `content/concepts/` for reusable explanations
- [ ] Estimated time is realistic
